# Post-wash checklist

Conditioning first: lay flat at room temperature for the frozen conditioning time before any
measurement. A garment measured warm out of the dryer is not the garment the protocol
describes.

- [ ] Conditioning time elapsed and recorded
- [ ] All measurements taken again, twice each (see the measurement sheet)
- [ ] Garment mass re-weighed

## Hem mapping

The macro series has to cover the WHOLE loop of each cut hem with no gap. The app's HEM tab
shows which measurement positions are covered and which are not; a gap there is a hole in the
fray profile, not a rounding detail.

- a 17 cm leg opening is a 170 mm loop: 8 positions every 20 mm, 3 macro frames
- a 20 cm leg opening is a 200 mm loop: 10 positions every 20 mm, 3 macro frames
- a 25 cm leg opening is a 250 mm loop: 12 positions every 20 mm, 4 macro frames
